items.title: Aion Labs 免费 API
items.quota: Permanent free tier, no credit card required. 15 RPM, 20K tokens/day. Specialized for roleplay and storytelling.｜免费模型 4 个：aion-labs/aion-2.0、aion-labs/aion-rp-llama-3.1-8b、aion-labs/aion-3.0、aion-labs/aion-3.0-mini｜限速: 15 RPM, 20K TPD

items.title: Cohere 免费 API

items.title: Google Gemini 免费 API
items.quota: Free tier, no credit card. Free-tier prompts may be used by Google to improve products.｜免费模型 10 个：Gemini 3.7 Flash、Gemini 3.6 Flash、Gemini 3.5 Flash、Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite、Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite、Gemini 2.5 Flash等｜限速: 15 RPM, 1,500 RPD；30 RPM, 1,500 RPD；5 RPM, 50 RPD

items.title: NVIDIA NIM 免费 API
items.quota: Free with NVIDIA Developer Program membership. 100+ models. Rate-limited per model.｜免费模型 12 个：nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b、nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b、nvidia/llama-3.1-nemotron-ultra-253b-v1、meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct、mistralai/mistral-nemotron、google/gemma-4-31b-it等｜限速: 40 RPM, 10,000 RPD

items.title: OVHcloud AI Endpoints 免费 API
items.quota: Free anonymous tier (no API key, no signup): 2 RPM per IP per model. 20+ open-weight models hosted in EU. OpenAI SDK-compatible.｜免费模型 12 个：Qwen3.5-397B-A17B、gpt-oss-120b、gpt-oss-20b、Meta-Llama-3_3-70B-Instruct、Qwen3.6-27B、Qwen3.5-9B等｜限速: 2 RPM (anonymous)
